_about: Everyone a slice quest places who has no quest topic of their own (owner walk 4, 2026-11-08: everyone in the places the slice quests touch has dialogue). One reply each to the prompt, built into ARG_Talk (QuestPeople in Talk.cs) gated GetIsID to the base; 'when' gates it on a quest's stage (lo inclusive, hi exclusive).

lines: Finds-The-Other-Bank. I was sold on from the lower channel with the families. Keep your voice down while Wuleen-Sei reads, or she starts the line again.
Finds-The-Other-Bank. I came out of that fire on my own legs. The roll burned. I do not know yet whether that is good.
Ri'Sakka. This one owes eleven months, and the broker adds two more for every winter of bread. Do not eat more than you must.
Ri'Sakka. This one ran when the huts caught. Now there is no roll and no overseer, and Ri'Sakka is wet and has no bread.
Tsanji. Ri'Sakka and I came on together, off a caravan that went bad. Stay near the middle of the gang on the shore path. The ends get the heavy loads.
Tsanji. I saw the woman with the knotted cord walk out of the smoke. She looked at no one but you.
Llarvi Maryon. I signed my months in Lilmoth for a debt I can no longer remember. Your line is blank, they say. Lucky. Mine is very full.
Llarvi Maryon. Whatever I owed burned with the roll. I will walk back to Lilmoth and see who still remembers it.
To the camp on Hereguard Plantation, where the shore path meets the reeds. Keep up with the gang. I count heads at the fire.
Finds-The-Other-Bank. We walk the shore path to the camp now. Stay with the gang; there is soft ground under the reeds.
Mee-Tuja, a courier for the state. I carry papers upriver and I walk with your gang as far as the camp. Ask me nothing about what is in the satchel.
Sal-Sei. I keep the clutch in the hatching shed, by the cutting we brought down from Nine Bends. Walk around the shed, not through it.
Sal-Sei. I kept the clutch. They cut the roots, and the eggs are dead. You pulled me out, and I will not forget it.
Deesh-Duun. My family keeps the huts over the water. Mind the plank boards; two of them are loose and we have no nails.
Deesh-Duun. I saw her face in the smoke as close as I see yours. I would know her again anywhere.
Nesh-Neel, of the families here. Sit by the fire when Wuleen-Sei reads. She counts the ones who sit.
No one you need to remember. Go and sit by your fire.
Salts-The-Catch. I watch this door for the one in the back room. Go in if you are expected. If you are not, go back to the dock.
A stranger on a shore. If you were at that camp last night, someone in Lilmoth wants to hear about it. Not from me.
Hides-His-Wake. I work this camp and I do not talk about it with strangers. Move along.
Counts-The-Jars. I count what comes in and what goes out. You are neither. Go.
I work for the estate. This landing is the estate's, and so is what is tied up at it. Keep walking.
I keep this gate. No one goes into the stone house without a word from inside. Do you have one? Then go.
A lookout. I watch the stair and the water. Talk to Bent-Spine, not to me.
I watch the water. If you came down the trapdoor, Bent-Spine knows already.
